boolean-exclude.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
boolean-exclude.modifications: Adapted the opposing open remnants used to distinguish XOR. Rebuilt from the shared Master square operands, with native dimensions, corner profiles and stroke-dependent openings.

line-height.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
line-height.modifications: Adapted the capital-letter-between-rules construction. Replaced the letter with the shared Master capital A and native optical layout, stroke, corner and spacing choices.

letter-spacing.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
letter-spacing.modifications: Adapted the capital-letter-between-rules construction. Replaced the letter with the shared Master capital A and native optical layout, stroke, corner and spacing choices.

text-direction-ltr.author: Paweł Kuna
text-direction-ltr.modifications: Adapted the paragraph-over-directional-arrow layout. Rebuilt from the shared Master pilcrow and horizontal arrow mothers, with compact native paragraph dimensions, wider separation and a non-mirrored pilcrow for both directions.

text-direction-rtl.author: Paweł Kuna
text-direction-rtl.modifications: Adapted the paragraph-over-directional-arrow layout. Rebuilt from the shared Master pilcrow and horizontal arrow mothers, with compact native paragraph dimensions, wider separation and a non-mirrored pilcrow for both directions.

flip-horizontal.author: Paweł Kuna
flip-horizontal.modifications: Adapted the mirrored right-triangle and central-axis construction. Rebuilt with the shared Master triangle mother, wider triangle counters, native corner radii and axis spacing.

flip-vertical.author: Paweł Kuna
flip-vertical.modifications: Adapted the mirrored right-triangle and central-axis construction. Rebuilt with the shared Master triangle mother, wider triangle counters, native corner radii and axis spacing.

group.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
group.modifications: Adapted enclosing selection corners versus separated objects. Rebuilt with the Master selection mother and shared rectangle geometry; diagonally offset operands retain independent counters and a clear vertical gap at 16px.

ungroup.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
ungroup.modifications: Adapted enclosing selection corners versus separated objects. Rebuilt with the Master selection mother and shared rectangle geometry; diagonally offset operands retain independent counters and a clear vertical gap at 16px.

node-corner.author: Phosphor Icons
node-corner.modifications: Variant of the shared Master bezier-curve mother, whose three-anchor construction derives from Phosphor. Preserves the same anchors and native spacing; replaces the smooth curve and tangent handle with two straight incident segments.

stroke-cap-butt.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
stroke-cap-butt.modifications: Adapted the open stroke-envelope and dashed-centerline construction. Rebuilt as shared native cap/join families with explicit 16/20/24 dimensions, optical guide lengths and gaps, stroke-scaled endpoint markers, and small corner treatments that preserve the depicted parameter.

stroke-cap-round.modifications: Adapted the open stroke-envelope and dashed-centerline construction. stroke-width.author: The Bootstrap Authors
stroke-width.modifications: Adapted the three descending-weight specimens, with native insets, spacing, weight-dependent thickness and actual sharp/soft/rounded strip corners.

corner-radius.author: Paweł Kuna
corner-radius.modifications: Adapted the isolated top-left circular corner; rebuilt native insets, straight lengths, optical radii and Master strokes. The semantic radius remains circular in all corner presets.

stroke-dashed.author: Paweł Kuna
stroke-dashed.modifications: Adapted the dashed line specimen using the shared Master minus centreline. Simplified to two longer dashes at 16px, three at 20/24px, with native gaps and explicit flat caps.

stroke-dotted.author: Paweł Kuna
stroke-dotted.modifications: Adapted the five circular dots into the shared Master minus centreline, with native centre spacing. Added an optical minimum dot diameter for thin strokes; all corner presets retain circular dots.

border-all.author: Paweł Kuna
border-all.modifications: Adapted the full/none cell border diagram to the shared Master square bounds and native radii. Full borders have flush flat-ended dividers; no-border guides use real circles with optical diameter floors and an evenly spaced lattice for all corner presets.

border-none.author: Paweł Kuna
border-none.modifications: Adapted the full/none cell border diagram to the shared Master square bounds and native radii. Full borders have flush flat-ended dividers; no-border guides use real circles with optical diameter floors and an evenly spaced lattice for all corner presets.

border-outer.author: Paweł Kuna
border-outer.modifications: Adapted the selected solid edge and dotted cell-guide convention. Reuses the Master square bounds and optical dot sizes; omits guides on selected edges and retains a regular lattice for small-size separation.

border-inner.author: Paweł Kuna
border-inner.modifications: Adapted the selected solid edge and dotted cell-guide convention. Reuses the Master square bounds and optical dot sizes; omits guides on selected edges and retains a regular lattice for small-size separation.

border-horizontal.author: Paweł Kuna
border-horizontal.modifications: Adapted the selected solid edge and dotted cell-guide convention. Reuses the Master square bounds and optical dot sizes; omits guides on selected edges and retains a regular lattice for small-size separation.

border-vertical.author: Paweł Kuna
border-vertical.modifications: Adapted the selected solid edge and dotted cell-guide convention. Reuses the Master square bounds and optical dot sizes; omits guides on selected edges and retains a regular lattice for small-size separation.

border-top.author: Luca Burgio
border-top.modifications: Adapted the single-edge diagram with twelve perimeter/centre guide dots. Rebuilt with the shared Master cell bounds, native optical circle sizes and selected edge line; all dots remain circular across corner presets.

border-bottom.author: Luca Burgio
border-bottom.modifications: Adapted the single-edge diagram with twelve perimeter/centre guide dots. Rebuilt with the shared Master cell bounds, native optical circle sizes and selected edge line; all dots remain circular across corner presets.

border-left.author: Luca Burgio
border-left.modifications: Adapted the single-edge diagram with twelve perimeter/centre guide dots. Rebuilt with the shared Master cell bounds, native optical circle sizes and selected edge line; all dots remain circular across corner presets.

border-right.author: Luca Burgio
border-right.modifications: Adapted the single-edge diagram with twelve perimeter/centre guide dots. Rebuilt with the shared Master cell bounds, native optical circle sizes and selected edge line; all dots remain circular across corner presets.

hand-click.author: Paweł Kuna
hand-click.modifications: Adapted the index-up hand and radial click cues. Reused the existing Master palm/thumb contour; rebuilt finger pose, simplified folded crowns, native proportions and ray spacing. Phosphor hand-tap was compared for small-size density, not used as source paths.

polyline.author: Phosphor Icons
polyline.modifications: Adapted the rising four-node open polyline composition. Rebuilt node size, native stroke weights, point placement and line-to-node joins using the shared Master vector path mother; no upstream filled path is shipped.

replace.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
replace.modifications: Adapted the outgoing corner outline, bent replacement arrow and one/multiple token arrangement. Rebuilt from shared Master selection, keyboard-return arrow and square mothers, with native token dimensions, butt-ended selection corners and separated repeated edges.

replace-all.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
replace-all.modifications: Adapted the outgoing corner outline, bent replacement arrow and one/multiple token arrangement. Rebuilt from shared Master selection, keyboard-return arrow and square mothers, with native token dimensions, butt-ended selection corners and separated repeated edges.

signal-bars.author: Paweł Kuna
signal-bars.modifications: Adapted the four separated ascending antenna strokes. Authored wider native spacing, native heights and baseline placement for 16/20/24; shared all corners through straight-stroke geometry and the system cap profiles.

incognito.author: Hugeicons
incognito.modifications: Adapted the hat-over-round-spectacles arrangement. Crown contour, single shared brim, native scale and spacing reconstructed; spectacle rings and transparent bridge joins directly share the existing Master glasses mother. No upstream SVG path is transformed. Material Design Icons is a filled-silhouette comparison only.

page-break.author: Paweł Kuna
page-break.modifications: Adapted the folded-page split with three horizontal break segments. The outer boundary and fold directly reuse Master fileParts; the painted boundary is cut by a native-width horizontal band. Rebuilt dash lengths, native placement and clearance; original file geometry preserved.

hotspot.author: Hugeicons
hotspot.modifications: Adapts the two open-bottom concentric wavefronts and central emitter arrangement. Circular arcs are reconstructed in native grids with a shared angular opening; the hollow emitter is simplified to a filled point, with optical radii and spacing. Tabler access-point is a comparison only.

screen-rotate.author: Hugeicons
screen-rotate.modifications: Adapts the diagonal device with opposed quarter-turn arrows. The device directly reuses Master smartphoneShape with native optical dimensions and omitted home bar. Each arrow is one continuous circular arc with one inward wing and an actual tip fillet; the second is its exact 180-degree counterpart. Material Design Icons is comparison-only.

bell-snooze.author: Paweł Kuna
bell-snooze.modifications: Adapts the interior Z notification-pause convention. The existing Master bell constructor is reused with unchanged native defaults; at heavier sharp widths its optional clapper drop preserves clearance. The native Z has clipped sharp joins, real soft/rounded fillets and optical spacing at heavier widths. Meaning is paused delivery, not rescheduling one reminder. Material Design Icons is comparison-only.

image-wrap-left.author: Paweł Kuna
image-wrap-left.modifications: Adapts the object-frame with adjacent text-line arrangement. Frame directly reuses Master imageFrame with explicit native optical bounds and radii. Landscape details are omitted because this control describes text flow, not image content. Left/right share exact mirrored geometry; inline relocates the frame into a paragraph line with text on its baseline and full lines above/below. MDI and ONLYOFFICE remain comparison-only.

image-wrap-right.author: Paweł Kuna
image-wrap-right.modifications: Adapts the object-frame with adjacent text-line arrangement. Frame directly reuses Master imageFrame with explicit native optical bounds and radii. Landscape details are omitted because this control describes text flow, not image content. Left/right share exact mirrored geometry; inline relocates the frame into a paragraph line with text on its baseline and full lines above/below. MDI and ONLYOFFICE remain comparison-only.

image-inline.author: Paweł Kuna
image-inline.modifications: Adapts the object-frame with adjacent text-line arrangement. Frame directly reuses Master imageFrame with explicit native optical bounds and radii. Landscape details are omitted because this control describes text flow, not image content. Left/right share exact mirrored geometry; inline relocates the frame into a paragraph line with text on its baseline and full lines above/below. MDI and ONLYOFFICE remain comparison-only.

footnote.author: Microsoft Corporation
footnote.modifications: Adapts the Ab with raised 1 text-reference composition. Reconstructs all glyphs using the shared Master capitalA, lowerB and heading numeral functions, with native 16/20/24 layout and stroke/corner treatment. ONLYOFFICE and LibreOffice are comparison-only sources.

selection-invert.author: Phosphor Icons
selection-invert.modifications: Adapts the solid/dashed half-frame with diagonal inversion motif. Rebuilds the frame directly from the Master selection mother, adding continuous-edge parameters; diagonal endpoints meet the native rounded-corner arcs. MDI and GIMP are comparison-only.

decimal-increase.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
decimal-increase.modifications: Adapts the .00/right-arrow and .0/left-arrow decimal display motif. Rebuilds the numerals with the shared Master numeral helper and arrows with horizontalArrow, using native 16/20/24 spacing. Structural zero shoulders stay round across corner presets. MDI comparison-only.

decimal-decrease.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
decimal-decrease.modifications: Adapts the .00/right-arrow and .0/left-arrow decimal display motif. Rebuilds the numerals with the shared Master numeral helper and arrows with horizontalArrow, using native 16/20/24 spacing. Structural zero shoulders stay round across corner presets. MDI comparison-only.

drop-cap.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
drop-cap.modifications: Adapts the oversized initial beside two short paragraph lines and one full-width line. Rebuilds the initial directly through the shared Master capitalA helper, with native 16/20/24 dimensions and line spacing. Hugeicons Free is comparison-only.

signature.author: Paweł Kuna / Tabler Icons
signature.modifications: Redrawn broader loop, raised initial, descending handwritten shoulders and softened tangent joins; native optical sizing and stroke controls. No underline or pen badge added.
